{{Otheruses|Wood}}
'''Kriin-wood''' was an expensive, dark-[[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Wood/Legends|wood]] from [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] used to make furniture, as well as a [[cavernhorn]].<ref name="RotSN">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref>

[[Set Harth]] had an extravagant desk hand carved out of kriin oak in the study of his [[Set Harth's mansion|mansion]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].<ref name="DB3 DoE">''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]''</ref> A wine-dark tabletop aboard the ''[[Tantive IV/Legends|Tantive IV]]'' was made from polished kriin.<ref name="RotSN" />
